lines.zh: 我贴着高空往你那边滑。
lines.en: I glide your way high overhead.
I streak beneath the clouds.
My membrane spreads to catch the wind.
I fly high; you cannot hear me.
I bank without losing speed.
I carve an arc from above.
I skim over the treetops.
I dive all the way down.
My shadow sweeps the ground first.
I beat my membrane and level out.
I route around the tall terrain.
I fly lower, closing on you.
I hang high, barely moving.
My membrane fans slowly.
I wait for the wind to carry me down.
I hang like a scrap of cloth.
Something is riding on my back.
I make no sound, only drift.
My tendrils reach downward.
I hold my altitude.
The wind pushes me crooked.
I am listening to the steps below.
I lower my head from high above.

lines.zh: 我的薄膜挡住了一片天。
lines.en: My membrane blots out a patch of sky.
I stare at you and hold still.
You are directly below me now.

lines.zh: 我把身体转成俯冲的角。
lines.en: I angle my body to dive.
My tendrils sway above your head.
You look up—and I'm right overhead.
I do not blink, and need not.

lines.zh: 我在你视野的上缘悬着。
lines.en: I hang at the upper edge of your vision.

lines.zh: 我把触须朝你的方向摆。
lines.en: I swing my tendrils toward you.
A hole tears in my membrane.
I rise a little to dodge.
My tendrils curl up.
I skid half a meter, then drift back.
I leak out a very soft breath.
My body sways.
I pause a beat before going on.
Wind whistles through my torn edge.
I sink a block.

lines.zh: 碎屑从我破开的边掉下去。
lines.en: Debris falls from my torn edge.
I sniff and veer away.

lines.zh: 地上的东西我半点不沾。
lines.en: I don't touch a thing on the ground.
The smell slows me a little.
I circle once above.
I read it as a trap.
I dip half a block and rise again.
I touch the air with a tendril.

lines.zh: 我更想吸你身上的东西。
lines.en: I would rather drain what you carry.
I can't even be bothered to touch it.
I turn and keep looking down.
You hit my membrane.

lines.zh: 我的薄膜闷闷地撞上你。
lines.en: My membrane hits you with a dull thud.
I am not knocked aside.
My tendrils knock you backward.
My tendrils scrape you.
I skim right over your head.
I fly too low and hit a tree.
My membrane wrinkles from the hit.
You cannot shake me off at all.
My edge grazes your shoulder blade.
Two of us circle side by side up high.
Our membranes brush.
I wheel close against its membrane.

lines.zh: 我和它顺着气流一起下坠。
lines.en: It and I sink together on the air current.
Its tendrils hook mine.
We cross paths beneath the clouds.
They ride on our backs.
Our shadows merge on the ground.
We rise together.
Neither of us ever lands.

lines.zh: 我俯冲下去抓那样东西。
lines.en: I dive to grab that thing.
My tendrils coil around it.
I carry it back up.
It swings beneath me.
I tuck it into my membrane folds.
I grip it tight; the wind cannot take it.
I look, then let it drop.
It is too heavy; I tilt.
I let it dangle below.
I climb while holding it.
I drop one block.
My tendrils draw in.
I have locked on directly below.
The wind delivers you to me.
I am set to dive.
I begin tipping your way.
My membrane spreads wide.
A warm scent rises.
I stop circling.
This height is just right.

lines.zh: 我认出了会喘气的活物。
lines.en: I recognize something that breathes.
I descend, fast.
My shadow shrinks to a spot.
I stretch myself straight and aim at you.
You hear the wind above.
I hang above and follow.
Wherever you run, my shadow follows.
I lower myself bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我盘着圈一直压在你上方。
lines.en: I circle in a tightening ring above you.
You enter the woods; I am on the canopy.
No hurry; up here is safe.
I wait for a good angle.
You look up; I am past the clouds.

lines.zh: 我的薄膜在风里鼓起来。
lines.en: My membrane billows in the wind.
You retreat; I bank along.
I count how far you can still go.
You are always beneath me.
I pass through a hole in the cloud.
My tendrils are already spread.
I know which way you are headed.
I stay directly over you.
I wait for the wind to drop.
You stop, and I press down.

lines.zh: 我撞在你肩上，没被弹开。
lines.en: I slam your shoulder and am not bounced away.
My tendrils wrap your arm.
I press down with my whole body.
My membrane whips your face.
I crash into your chest from above.

lines.zh: 我没被击退，贴着你不放。
lines.en: I am not knocked back; I stay stuck to you.
You shove me and I am still on you.
My tendrils cling to your skin.
The impact pins you down.
I cut in from the upper side.
You pull off; I dive again.
After the hit I stay latched, clinging.
My body hitting you makes a rush of wind.
You slide backward from the hit.
I drive you back against a stone.
I do not dodge your hands.
Something up there is moving.
I come down from high above.
Something above seventy-eight blocks has woken.
A membrane blots out the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我的影子落进你的院子。
lines.en: My shadow falls into your yard.
You hear wind overhead.
A string of tendrils hangs from a cloud gap.
It suddenly grew cold here.

lines.zh: 我从很远的高处滑下来。
lines.en: I glide down from very high.

lines.zh: 天空多了个不落地的东西。
lines.en: The sky has gained something that never lands.
You look up and see nothing.
I begin to exist overhead.
A shadow slowly grows.
The air is pressed low by wind.

lines.zh: 火沿我的薄膜烧开一条边。
lines.en: Fire eats an edge along my membrane.

lines.zh: 我从高空摔下，薄膜先着地。
lines.en: I fall from high and land on my membrane.
I drop into water and cannot take off.
The blast flips me whole.

lines.zh: 箭扎穿我的薄膜，风漏了。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my membrane and the wind leaks.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我按在原地。
lines.en: That force pins me in place.
Hunger makes my flight unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，整片薄膜发亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole membrane glows.

lines.zh: 下面的世界没了，我落下去。
lines.en: The world below is gone; I drop.
